notes: An emergency is any situation that requires immediate assistance from the police, fire department or ambulance; in an emergency dial 911. Source: https://www.911.gov/calling-911/, retrieved 2026-09-26.

Text-to-911 is only available in certain locations; always make a voice call to 911 if you can. Where texting is not supported, carriers send an automatic bounce-back message. Source: https://www.fcc.gov/consumers/guides/what-you-need-know-about-text-911 (FCC), retrieved 2026-09-26.
